name: narration
quote: I think that's what's going on.
description: Weaving what's happening into an internal story acceptable to yourself and important social groups.

variations.name: self-interested narration
variations.description: Ambitiously slanting the internal narrative so you look good or the other looks bad.

variations.name: principled narration
variations.description: Trying to build an accurate internal story even if there are aspects that cast shade you or important others.

commentaries.quote: Honestly trying to summarize what's happening across your 86 billion neurons is a difficult task because much of what's happening is unconcious. There are subtle signs available, but we often find it advantageous to ignore them.

Evolution has shaped us with perceptions that allow us to survive. But part of that involves hiding from us the stuff we don’t need to know. And that’s pretty much all of reality, whatever that might be.

Underlying the internal narration is a sense that the story is critical both in content and vibe. We have to know what's going on to be in control. We have to know what's going on to be able to answer to our social groups and to our gods.

conditions: Impulses or sensations are happening that need to be accounted for in the model of the environment.
